summary: Prompt 5 (Staff Master + Leave Foundation) full regression + E2E. Backend: pytest 150/150 pass in 27.96s (89 foundation/CRM/admissions/student + 2 endpoint + 36 academic + 23 staff). Frontend: registered fresh tenants via /api/v1/auth/register-school, exercised every /school/staff/* page end-to-end. StaffPage (/school/staff) renders data-testid staff-page with all 4 KPI tiles (kpi-total, kpi-active, kpi-teaching, kpi-pending) reading 0. btn-new-employee opens dialog; leaving ne-code blank produced EMP-2026-0001 auto-code on submit and the row appeared with success toast 'Employee created'. DepartmentsDesignationsPage (/school/staff/dept-desig): tab-depts/tab-desigs switch; created 'Science/SCI' department (dept-del-{id} rendered) and 'Teacher/TCH' designation (desig-del-{id} rendered). LeaveTypesPage (/school/staff/leave-types): btn-new-leave-type dialog exposes lt-preset Radix Select with all 7 presets (CL/SL/EL/CO/ML/PL/LWP); picking 'Casual Leave (CL)' auto-populated lt-name='Casual Leave' and lt-code='CL'; lt-submit created the row with lt-active-{id} toggle and lt-del-{id} rendered. LeaveApplicationsPage (/school/staff/leaves): la-status-filter and btn-apply-leave both render. StaffDetailPage (/school/staff/{id}): renders staff-detail, header 'EMP-2026-0001 · Bob Test · ACTIVE · Full Time', staff-status-select (options: active/probation/on leave/suspended/resigned/terminated/retired/notice period) + staff-status-reason + staff-status-apply all functional (status changed to on_leave). All 4 tabs (stab-overview/stab-quals/stab-docs/stab-leave) present with correct sub-sections (Identity/Contact/Employment/Attendance Hooks, btn-add-qual, btn-add-doc, Balances + Applications panes). Sidebar 'STAFF' group renders Employees / Departments & designations / Leave types. Zero console/pageerrors during flows.
critical_code_review_comments: shadcn/Radix Select components (lt-preset, ne-dept-select, ne-desig-select, staff-status-select) are not native <select> — Playwright/testing tools must use click + role=option interaction. Consider documenting this in a testing README so agents don't blow time on select_option calls.

StaffDetailPage 'Apply' button remains visually disabled-looking (gray) even when a status is selected until reason is typed; on click it does work — consider enabling the visual state when status is chosen and reason optional (or make reason clearly required).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed data-testids present and interactive across all 5 staff pages
